name: LandSignal
install:
cd apps/web && npm ci
cd apps/api && python3 -m pip install -e . -q

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Next.js web UI — Cursor auto-forwards port 3000 into the right-side browser

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd apps/api && AUTO_DISCOVER_ON_STARTUP=false LAND_ALERTS_MONITOR_ENABLED=false python3 -m uvicorn landsignal.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: API behind Next /v1 rewrite on port 8000
